facts.rationale: Corrects the blanket assertion that retry skips record processing by preserving the cross-file cached-record writeback preceding the guard.
facts.value: The mode dispatches CSS as state 0 and VS gameplay as state 1. CSS pending change 2 schedules the menu before roster mutation; other values prepare the retained fighter-versus-Sandbag setup. VS exit performs initial bookkeeping and cached-record writeback before testing `OUTCOME_RETRY`. Retry requests state 1 using the retained setup and skips only the subsequent distance-record and threshold pipeline. Every non-retry outcome runs that pipeline, then either stages Challenger Approach or requests CSS state 0.
